title: Compliance Note — Address Notice-Period Check Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
A move that falls inside, or shortly before, the period of a notice of cancellation draws a check on an address amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate. The address notice-period check charge compares the effective date of the latest garaging change recorded within the past month on the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records with the latest notice of cancellation on the named insured's Cardinal Billing Account ledger — its mail date and its cancellation effective date.

| Garaging change took effect | Address notice-period check charge |
|---|---|
| On or after the notice's mail date and on or before its cancellation effective date | 4.00 |
| Before the mail date, and no more than 30 calendar days before it | 2.00 |
| At any other time | None |
| No notice of cancellation, or no garaging change, on record | None |

"Within the past month" covers garaging changes whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today. The notice compared is the latest notice of cancellation on the billing ledger.

## Timeline (hypothetical notice mailed 10 March 2026, cancellation effective 30 March 2026)

| Move effective | Position | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 7 February 2026 | 31 days before the mail date | None |
| 8 February 2026 | 30 days before the mail date | 2.00 |
| 9 March 2026 | 1 day before the mail date | 2.00 |
| 10 March 2026 | On the mail date | 4.00 |
| 30 March 2026 | On the cancellation effective date | 4.00 |
| 31 March 2026 | After the cancellation effective date | None |
